name: Sol 72 Outdoor Boynton 3 Piece Bar Set
description: Sol 72 Outdoor Whether youre enjoying casual cocktails by the pool or serving up snacks during an at-home happy hour, this three-piece bar set is the perfect pick for your patio! Crafted with a rust-resistant metal frame, each weather-resistant piece showcases solid acacia wood slats in a dark brown tone for a warm and inviting look. Two low-back bar stools provide a place for a few friends to sit back and relax, while the table has two hidden shelves to hold spirits, stemware, mixers, and more. Assembly is required.
